fact: The Cabo Verde Ministry of Finance terms of reference seek technical assistance to develop and implement SIMple territory management modules for municipalities to insert and manage cadastral information on lots, buildings and usage rights.

The PEO allows property transfers to be carried out through the platform, with the integrated participation of the Notary, the Land Registry (Conservatoria do Registo Predial), the municipal council and the Cadastre services (INGT).
